Meet the Team
Join Cisco's Webex Media engineering site in Stockholm, where we craft the meeting experience that connects people and businesses around the world. We are a highly motivated, startup‑like team within a global organization, combining the impact and resources of Cisco with the agility and camaraderie of a smaller group. Our work powers the shift to a hybrid workforce and aims to make people feel truly connected. You’ll find a friendly, supportive environment that celebrates creativity, growth, and a shared passion for building world‑class real‑time audio algorithm experiences.

Your Impact
Design, implement, and optimize VoIP audio algorithms—including adaptive jitter buffers, packet loss concealment, and codec pipelines—based on product requirements.
Perform peer code reviews and automate development workflows and quality gates.
Participate in agile ceremonies including daily stand‑ups, planning, releases, and retrospectives.
Collaborate across teams to broaden technical and soft skills through training and mentoring.

Minimum Qualifications:
MSc (or equivalent) in Software Engineering or a related field.
Hands-on experience developing VoIP or real‑time audio algorithms (e.g., adaptive jitter buffer, packet loss concealment, codec integration) in production systems.
Proficiency in C/C++ with strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real‑time applications.
Professional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Uses AI responsibly to accelerate development.
Critically reviews AI-generated code before using it.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience applying AI/ML to audio algorithm development or optimization in production voice systems.
Experience evaluating and tuning audio algorithms using objective metrics (e.g., POLQA, PESQ) and subjective listening tests.
Experience with close‑to‑real‑time systems and performance‑sensitive code paths.
Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
Collaborative, friendly, and self‑directed; eager to learn and share knowledge.
Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.

Why Cisco? 
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Senior Product Development Project Manager – Service Market Technology
Are you an experienced project manager who enjoys leading cross-functional teams, managing project deliveries, and driving business results? Join Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB and explore an opportunity to contribute to product development projects with a strong focus on service market and aftermarket technology.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Development Project Manager to lead Service Market Technology (SMT) activities across product development and change projects.
You will ensure that SMT deliverables meet agreed project requirements, budgets, milestones, and quality expectations. Working closely with project teams and key stakeholders, you will coordinate plans, integrate service market requirements into overall project activities, and drive successful delivery throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the SMT project team through project milestones and gate reviews, ensuring agreed targets and deliverables are achieved.
Own, manage, and monitor SMT budgets within assigned projects.
Develop and track SMT project schedules in collaboration with the team.
Provide input to overall project timelines and ensure alignment with key milestones.
Coordinate SMT requirements and deliverables with project plans, including verification and validation activities.
Ensure all SMT commitments are clearly defined and delivered according to the project description.
Identify stakeholder needs and align project activities with business and technical requirements.
Monitor progress, identify risks, and drive timely resolution of issues.
Build strong relationships across cross-functional teams to support effective decision-making and delivery.

Required Qualifications
Proven project management experience in product development or a similar technical environment.
Strong planning, budgeting, coordination, and delivery management skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate alternative solutions and make decisions with limited information.
Ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining focus on business objectives and delivery quality.
A pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset with a proactive and positive attitude.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

Nice to Have
Experience in aftermarket or service market technology.
Project management experience in both traditional Waterfall and Agile environments.
Background in process and product development.
Experience with aftermarket documentation and related deliverables.

Who Should Apply?
We are looking for a business-oriented project leader who can take a holistic view, bring diverse stakeholders together, and translate requirements into reliable project outcomes. You should be comfortable working across functions, making informed decisions, and driving progress in a dynamic product development environment.
📩 Interested in this opportunity? Explore this and other opportunities through the Hykmann careers portal: https://www.hykmann.com/careers

Arbetsplats: Tumba, Stockholm
Anställningsform: Heltid
Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
Lön: Enligt överenskommelse, baserat på erfarenhet
Om tjänsten
Vi söker en erfaren och självgående bilplåtslagare / bilskadereparatör / billackerare till vår bilverkstad i Tumba, Stockholm.
Vår verkstad arbetar med bilreparationer och underhåll av fordon. Vi söker nu en skicklig medarbetare som har erfarenhet av att reparera krockskadade och olycksskadade bilar.
Vi söker dig som kan hantera hela reparationsprocessen, från skadebedömning och karosseriarbete till förberedelse och lackering av fordon.
Arbetsuppgifter
Reparera krockskadade och olycksskadade fordon.
Utföra bilplåtslageri och karosseriarbeten.
Rikta och reparera skadade karossdelar.
Byta ut och montera skadade bildelar.
Reparera bucklor, repor och andra karosseriskador.
Utföra spackling, slipning och grundmålning.
Förbereda fordon inför lackering.
Utföra professionell billackering och färgmatchning.
Kontrollera att utförda reparationer håller hög kvalitet.

Kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som:
Har tidigare erfarenhet av bilskadereparationer och karosseriarbeten.
Har praktiska kunskaper inom billackering.
Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.
Har erfarenhet av att reparera krockskadade fordon.
Är noggrann, pålitlig och kvalitetsmedveten.
Har god kunskap om verktyg och utrustning som används vid bilskadereparationer.

Meriterande
Erfarenhet av både bilplåtslageri och billackering.
Tidigare arbete på en skadeverkstad eller bilverkstad.

Vi erbjuder
Heltidsanställning.
Konkurrenskraftig lön baserad på erfarenhet.
Trevlig arbetsmiljö.
Varierande arbetsuppgifter med olika bilmärken och modeller.

Network Control team is looking to onboard a Software Developer at our development team located in Västerås, Sweden. The Software Developer drives development and maintenance activities, ensures high-quality software delivery, and collaborates closely with Product Management, System Architects, Quality Assurance, and Customer Delivery teams. This role contributes to the development of scalable, secure, and high-performance applications within Hitachi Energy's Network Control portfolio, including SCADA, EMS, DMS, ADMS, WAMS, and related platforms.

University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum 3 years of professional software development experience in enterprise, high-performance, or mission-critical software environments.

Proven experience in identifying root causes of complex software issues and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Comfortable working in customer-facing environments and taking part in technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

Technical Competencies
Expert proficiency in C# and .NET Framework/.NET platform development
Experience with C++ development is an added advantage.
Strong hands-on experience developing Windows desktop applications using WPF, Experience building rich client applications.
Experience with SQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL/Data Modeling/ Query Optimization / Database Performance Tunning
Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
Proficiency with GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, AI coding assistants, and intelligent code generation tools.

Are you an engineer with a passion for sustainable technology and smart system design? This is your chance to be part of a global organization at the forefront of energy innovation. We work with ongoing selection - submit your application today.
About the role
As an Electrical Engineer within Cooling Systems, you will take part in the design, development, testing, and coordination of electrical systems in advanced energy transmission projects. Your main focus will be on cooling solutions for high-power conversion technology.
You’ll be part of a dedicated product delivery team with colleagues both in Sweden and abroad. The role involves close collaboration with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and technical experts, making it ideal for someone who enjoys combining engineering depth with cross-functional teamwork.
Whether you're early in your career or bring years of experience – our client believes in continuous learning. You’ll receive a thorough onboarding, including a 5-week “engineering camp” at the site in Ludvika, to ensure you get a strong start.
Work tasks
Design and develop electrical solutions for cooling systems in large-scale energy projects
Work with automation, signal handling, and testing - including programming tasks
Collaborate with global project teams across long-term international projects (3–10 years)
Occasionally travel for testing or supplier follow-ups (a few times per year)

We are looking for
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or similar – with strong interest in electrical/automation systems
A genuine interest in technology and the transition to green energy
Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken (company language)
Willingness to travel when required (short trips a few times per year)

It's a plus if you have
Experience with cooling systems in industrial applications, automation, or electrical components
Background in technical project teams, testing, and documentation
Programming skills – any language is a bonus (e.g. MATLAB)
Swedish language skills

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive and collaborative
Goal-oriented
Responsible
Intellectually curious and eager to learn

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

What you'll do:
Within CERN's Finance and Administrative Processes Department (FAP), specifically the Accounting Services Group. We are looking for a dynamic person to join our General Accounting (GA) section and play an active role in the accounting of CERN's tangible and intangible assets, as well as its inventories. You will also support broader financial reporting activities and exciting accounting projects. There will be a particular focus on Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE).

As an experienced Accountant, you will join a team of seven professionals and play a key role in all activities related to asset accounting.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate regular register(s) updates and reviews of useful lives and residual values with other CERN stakeholders.
- Analyse CERN projects to identify new assets or consolidation/upgrade of existing assets.
- Perform accounting entries related to movements of assets, depreciation/amortisation, and impairment tests.
- Support the ongoing ERP transformation project touching the areas of asset accounting and financial accounts.
- Perform balance sheet account reconciliations, including a reconciliation of assets register(s) to financial accounts.
- Maintain policies, procedures, and controls to ensure efficient, accurate, and compliant asset accounting.
- Coordinate physical assets counts.
- Support external auditors queries.
- Support preparation of the Organization's Financial Statements, including assets related notes and disclosures.
- Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Your profile:
- Proven experience as a general accountant with a focus on asset accounting, such as Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE).
- Demonstrated experience with international accounting standards IFRS and/or IPSAS.
- Experience preferably acquired in a company handling large volumes of data or in an international organisation.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Accounting, Finance or a related field. Accounting certification, such as ACA, CA, CPA, etc.

Your skills:
- Accounting control and analysis, book-keeping and book-closing.
- Financial reporting and analysis, handling large volumes of data.
- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
- Uses openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
- Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Ria Money Transfer is a business arm of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT) and a leading financial services player. We offer fast, secure and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers worldwide. In addition to this, we also provide currency exchange services. With over 600,000 agents in almost 200 countries, our goal is to create opportunities for a better everyday life.
We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.
ABOUT THIS ROLE
Ria Financial Services is looking for a driven and service-oriented employee for the role of Sales Cashier/Store Employee. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.
This is a part-time position located in Linköping. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a central part of our team and the face of our business. You are responsible for providing an outstanding customer experience while contributing to achieving our sales goals.
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Carry out transactions for money transfers and currency exchange with high precision and efficiency.
Actively engage customers to understand their needs and offer appropriate financial services.
Provide personalized and professional service by answering questions and providing clear guidance.
Manage cash flow carefully and ensure accurate accounting according to company guidelines.
Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.
Be flexible with working hours and be able to work evenings, weekends and holidays when needed.

 
We are looking for you who

Has experience in sales and customer service (meritorious).
Fluent in Swedish and English – additional language skills are a plus (e.g. Russian, Ukrainian, Thai or Arabic, Farsi, Dari).

jobs.occupation: Family medicine specialist in border region of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in family medicine looking for a workplace with a supportive atmosphere, skilled colleagues and close access to beautiful nature?
This role offers the chance to work in a primary care centre located in a border region between Sweden and Norway, with short travel distance to Oslo and good connections to other parts of the country.
About the role
As a family medicine specialist, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team where all professional competences are valued. The centre provides care throughout life, from assessment and diagnostics to treatment, follow-up, and rehabilitation.
Primary care here is rapidly developing with a strong focus on accessibility, digital solutions, and close collaboration with patients. The work environment is characterized by teamwork, engagement, and patient focus.
We offer
Mentorship or professional guidance from experienced colleagues.
Regular opportunities for continuous professional development.
A workplace that promotes health and offers wellness benefits.
Support with practical matters in case of relocation, such as housing, schools, and integration.

Requirements
Medical license and specialist certification in family medicine/general practice from an EU/EEA country
Eligibility for recognition by the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen).
Good English skills and willingness to learn Swedish to B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Terms
Full-time, permanent position.
Start date by agreement.

Location
The area is known for its stunning natural surroundings with forests, lakes, and rich wildlife – perfect for those who appreciate outdoor life and a good work-life balance. You will also have easy access to cultural activities, sports and international cities.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

jobs.occupation: Lead Chef for Veranda, our chef table
jobs.description:
A hotel built from snow and ice sourced from the Torne River, featuring art created by selected artists who travel here from across the globe. Our operations include traditional hotel rooms and cabins, Icehotel 365, a hotel by night and an art gallery by day and, from mid-December to mid-April, our seasonal winter hotel made entirely of snow and ice.

We are passionate about creating enriching experiences and living in harmony with nature. In addition to the ice art, we offer nature-based activities and culinary experiences, both in-house and in collaboration with carefully selected partners, as a complement to the art.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Chef to lead our show-cooking experience at Veranda Restaurant at ICEHOTEL for the winter season 2026/2027. The Veranda experience is more than a dinner. It is a fine dining experience where we cook and present the food in front of our guests. Bring your experience, personality, skills and passion to help us share the story behind our new menu, inspired by the eight Sámi seasons.

Responsibilities

Lead the kitchen team at Veranda Restaurant.

Cook and present food in front of our guests.

Share the story behind the menu through storytelling as you cook.

Contribute ideas to the Veranda experience.

Who are you?

You bring a positive personality, ideas and a genuine passion for hospitality. You enjoy interacting with guests and are comfortable sharing the stories behind the food as you cook and present it.

Qualifications

Strong professional kitchen experience.

Previous experience in fine dining and leading a kitchen team is essential.

Comfortable working in a chef’s table and open-kitchen setting.

Experience with Nordic flavours and food culture.

Fluent English is required. Swedish is an advantage.

About the position

Type of employment: Seasonal employment for winter 2026/2027.

Start date: As agreed.

Location: Jukkasjärvi, Sweden.

Staff accommodation is available if needed.

What we offer

A unique workplace in one of the world’s most extraordinary environments.

The opportunity to take part in activities such as snowmobile safaris under the northern lights or ski tours with Swedish fika.

A supportive and inclusive team culture.

Staff benefits and discounts.

Applications are only accepted through this application platform. The position may be filled before the closing date, so don’t wait to apply. If you have any questions, please contact diego@icehotel.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About
We are looking for a technically driven Proposal Manager / Sales Engineer who thrives in the intersection between engineering, commercial business, and customer interaction.
In this role, you will take ownership of technical proposals and solution development for complex power conversion systems. You will work closely with customers, engineering teams, project managers, and sales colleagues to transform customer requirements into competitive and technically robust solutions.
This role requires a strong engineering mindset and the ability to engage in detailed technical discussions with customers, consultants, and OEM partners while maintaining a commercial perspective throughout the sales process.
You will also represent KraftPowercon at international trade fairs, conferences, and industry events, helping strengthen our market presence and build relationships with key stakeholders.
Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Solution Development
Analyze customer specifications and technical requirements.

Define and develop solution concepts for rectifier, inverter, DC system, battery, hydrogen and power conversion applications.

Act as technical lead during quotation and proposal activities.

Perform technical risk assessments and identify deviations from customer specifications.

Coordinate technical clarifications with engineering, sourcing, manufacturing and service teams.

Proposal Management
Lead the proposal process from RFQ to final customer submission.

Prepare technical and commercial proposals.

Manage proposal schedules and customer deadlines.

Ensure proposal quality, compliance and competitiveness.

Drive internal bid reviews and approval processes.

Customer Engagement
Participate in customer meetings and technical workshops.

Conduct technical presentations and solution discussions.

Support negotiations from a technical perspective.

Build trusted relationships with OEM customers, EPCs, consultants and end-users.

Market & Business Development
Support identification of new applications and market opportunities.

Collect market intelligence and competitor insights.

Participate in international exhibitions, conferences and customer events.

Contribute to product positioning and value proposition development.

QualificationsRequired
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Energy Systems or equivalent.

Experience from proposal engineering, application engineering or technical sales.

Ability to understand and discuss electrical architectures, control systems and power electronics solutions.

Experience working with technical specifications, tenders and customer requirements.

Strong communication skills in English.

Preferred
Experience within power conversion, industrial power systems, energy systems, automation or related fields.

Knowledge of hydrogen, battery energy storage, data centers, marine electrification or industrial DC systems.

Experience of international business and OEM customers.

Familiarity with standards such as IEC, UL and grid connection requirements.

What Success Looks Like
You will be successful in this role if you can:

Translate complex technical requirements into winning solutions.

Serve as the customer's trusted technical advisor.

Bridge the gap between engineering excellence and commercial success.

Improve proposal quality, speed and hit rate.

Identify opportunities where KraftPowercon's technology creates clear customer value.

ARE YOU READY TO REINVENT MOBILITY? JOIN US AT EDAG AND BE PART OF OUR AGILE AND INTERNATIONAL TEAM
EDAG, one of the leading global engineering experts with heritage from the automotive industry, serves its customers with complete development responsibility, ranging from concept work to even building prototypes. Whether it is software development, development of future mobility solutions, sustainability, design engineering, quality assurance, manufacturing engineering or various other engineering requests, EDAG has for more than 50 years successfully helped its clients taking the next technology leap.
We at EDAG simply claim to be our customer’s global mobility engineering experts!
EDAG Engineering Scandinavia AB is the Scandinavian subsidiary of the EDAG Group. With an origin from Gothenburg, we have naturally become an important partner to the western region of Sweden. More and more customers are discovering our ability to deliver local engineering capabilities within a wide range of areas – not seldom in combination with other global EDAG sites, colleagues, and competences to accommodate larger projects and undertakings.
 We are looking for System/Requirement Engineers who will work on E-mobility, Electronics and Software Development areas, such as Autonomous Drive, Power Electronics, Active Safety, Functional Safety, Cyber Security, Vehicle Mode Management, Infotainment Systems, and more. You will be part of a global team of dynamic and innovative team that is preferred solution partner for the industry.

Your Responsibilities
Defining and analyzing system requirements and technical specifications
Reviewing electronics/software requirements-specifications
Managing suppliers in an international environment
Designing and developing test requirements-specifications
Responsible for issuing and changing management on developed models
Securing deliveries are ready in time, updated and released
Build and maintain personal network within R&D Organization

Our Requirements
M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree within Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or equivalent education
5 years of working experience in the related field
Knowledge in developing software algorithms and specifications
Knowledge in electronics and microprocessors (embedded systems)
Knowledge in automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, MOST, FlexRay and Ethernet)
Knowledge in Agile Product Development (Scrum, SAFe)
Knowledge in AUTOSAR
Knowledge in Automotive Functional Safety Standard ISO 26262
Knowledge in Automotive Cyber Security Standard ISO 21434
The experience with commercial vehicles is meritorious.
Fluent in English (written and spoken), Swedish is meritorious
B driving license

We Offer:
We can provide you exciting tasks with great colleagues developing your skills in true global EDAG project teams. Your base will be inhouse in our own facilities in Gothenburg, but you will have daily contacts with many more colleagues in other EDAG sites around the globe and of course great customers and suppliers.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Quality Associate is responsible for confirming key quality attributes of intermediate products and processes as well as identifying and responding to non-conformity issues in production. jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join a large transformation programme focused on developing a next-generation Trade Surveillance platform.
The platform is designed to identify and manage potential market abuse and ensure regulatory compliance across global financial markets.
You will act as a key link between business and IT, translating complex business needs into clear functional requirements. You will work closely with international surveillance teams in Europe and the USA, as well as development, product and other stakeholder teams.
What You Will Work On
Gather, analyse and translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Define, document, prioritize and test data-related and functional requirements.
Ensure solutions balance business needs, technical feasibility and business value.
Collaborate with international Surveillance teams, Commercial teams and System Engineering.
Support project planning, requirements gathering and delivery follow-up.
Identify and resolve delivery blockers.
Work with Risk, Compliance and Audit teams to validate requirements and address issues.
Manage and prioritize the project backlog.
Establish and improve processes and governance routines.
Lead the calibration and fine-tuning of surveillance models across asset classes, including equities and fixed-income instruments.
Support business-as-usual activities, including reviewing business initiatives, market abuse risk assessments and user queries.

What You Bring
Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst within capital markets, financial technology or a regulated trading environment.
Strong understanding of trading data structures, trading protocols, order management, execution flows and exchange rules.
Knowledge of financial instruments and asset classes, including equities, fixed income, derivatives, futures, forwards and options.
Proven ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into functional specifications, user stories and data flow diagrams.
Experience working in agile delivery environments.
Experience with JIRA and cross-functional development and product teams.
Strong analytical skills and advanced SQL-based data analysis capabilities.
Good English communication skills.

Meritorious
Experience with Trade Surveillance, compliance monitoring or regulatory frameworks such as MAR, MiFID II, FINRA, Nasdaq Market Model and Exchange Rules.
Experience with large-scale data integrations and multi-asset market data flows.
Knowledge of instrument reference data and differences between financial products from a surveillance perspective.
Experience working with global teams and international stakeholders.
Experience with surveillance platforms such as NMS, NTS, Actimize, Trading Hub, Scila or similar.
Understanding of surveillance system calibration.
Advanced JIRA experience, including backlog and sprint planning.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
